_note: What the customers say over the dialogue strip, in both halves of the game. build.mjs INLINES this as const DIALOGUE - never fetched at runtime (CSP, file:// CORS). Edit here or in Service Mode, then run: node build.mjs
_rules: ALL CAPS, 5x7 font characters only, and a line wraps to at most 2 rows of the speech bubble beside the widest baked face (34 characters a row). build.mjs rejects anything else and says how much to trim.
_era: There are no shared lines (owner, 2026-11-09): every customer says only their own, so nothing carries an era floor; a face is placed by its decade. The 2|/3| prefix the shared pools used is refused on a personal line.
_voice: Every customer in their own voice: the Midwest regulars, the trucker, the lunch-break dad, the bridge-club grandma, sharper and saltier since 2026-11-09 (owner: "grittier and a little filthier, a little more adult"; "funnier when they are pissed off"). Mild swearing and innuendo are in; the strongest swear words, slurs, jokes at anyone's identity and anything explicit are out, and children stay clean. A handful of faces are weirdly filthy for their type on purpose. Nothing from after the year on screen. The game is public.
_keys: people[face] holds all 13 moments. Delivery Shift: delivered (on time), perfect (dead centre on the mat), late (the tip ran down), missed (off the porch), nearmiss (a passer-by nearly run down), fender (the driver of a car the player crunched). Kitchen Shift: arrive (a new ticket), wait (patience under 30%), queue (the line is past 3), wrong (a wrong pick), served, nailed (a clean ticket served fast), walkout (patience ran out). The build refuses a cast face with no line for one.
